history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). A young couple in what appears to be a photo booth, with a backdrop of soft, pink, vertical pleats. The woman, on the left, has long, dark hair that falls past her shoulders. Her head is slightly tilted, and she looks towards the viewer with a gentle, almost shy expression. A man, on the right, leans in and kisses her cheek. He has dark, neatly styled hair and is wearing a black crew-neck shirt. The lighting is soft and warm, casting a gentle glow on their faces and creating a romantic, intimate atmosphere. The overall color palette is dominated by soft pinks and the warm tones of their skin, with the dark clothing of the man providing a subtle contrast. The image has a slightly dreamy, soft-focus quality, enhancing the tender moment captured.
